Addresses the AskUserQuestion premise error directly, and is the same discipline behind the 'tell me instead of silently merging' and 'report those to me rather than deciding them yourself' guardrails: all three are cases where the user is protecting the decision surface from unchecked assertions. A question is an assertion too, and this session's was wrong. Costs one read before asking.

PREDICTION - Make the deliverable of a multi-task session a single consolidated report that is rebuilt in full at each checkpoint, rather than prose accumulated across turns. Addresses the 'buried by more recent messages' complaint, which was the only unprompted complaint of the session. The work was correct and complete; only its presentation failed, and it failed because a long agentic run scatters the report across the same scroll as the tool calls.

PREDICTION - Add a standing verification-reporting rule to CLAUDE.md: a claim that a harness component works must cite a direct probe (command plus its output), in-context evidence never counts as proof that a hook ran, and 'not yet determined' is an expected, acceptable verdict. PREDICTION - When the user gives a reason for a decision, write the reason to memory in the same turn, not just the decision. Addresses the deferred-agents item. The proposal to delete claim-auditor and red-team will keep regenerating, and what makes it answerable next time is the rationale, not the outcome. Generalises: this repo already learned the same lesson for limitations (LIMITATIONS.md exists because a limitation documented only at its call site is invisible from where it hurts).
